en.title: Travel Agency & Digital Nomad Portal — Website Design
en.tagline: Ten responsive page layouts for a travel portal and content hub.
en.description: A travel portal and content hub covering domestic and international packages, curated guided tours, digital-nomad resources and editorial travel writing. I designed ten responsive page layouts across desktop and mobile — home, guided tour, blog listing and article templates, about and contact — structuring the destination cards, the article reading template and the booking lead-capture. Sole website UI designer; the identity was another designer's and the WordPress build was a no-code developer's.
